1.Nf3 Nf6 2.c4 d5.name: English Opening: Anglo-Indian Defence, Scandinavian Defence

1.Nf3 Nf6 2.c4 d5 3.cxd5.strategy: Takes the pawn to clear the centre: the c-pawn is traded for Black's d-pawn, leaving White with d- and e-pawns against Black's single e-pawn in the middle. The game then turns on whether that central majority outweighs the activity Black's pieces gain.

1.Nf3 Nf6 2.c4 d5 3.cxd5 Nxd5.strategy: Recaptures with the knight, which lands on the best central square and keeps the queen at home. Black has traded the d-pawn for White's c-pawn and plays for piece activity against White's central pawn majority, but must take care not to lose time when the knight is challenged.
1.Nf3 Nf6 2.c4 d5 3.cxd5 Nxd5.name: English Opening: Anglo-Indian Defence, Scandinavian Defence, Exchange Variation
